name: a deploy four minutes before a 5xx spike on orders-api

alert.name: orders-api 5xx rate above 5%
alert.detail: 5xx responses rose from 0.3% to 6.8% in two minutes, and every failing response comes from POST /orders.

recent_changes.what: orders-api v6.4.0, which rewrote the validation on POST /orders
raised the log level on the search service to debug

name: the payment provider status page reports an outage and nothing shipped

alert.name: payments-worker charge attempts failing
alert.detail: Every charge attempt since 09:12 comes back as a 503 from the payment provider, whose status page reports degraded card processing. Our own endpoints answer normally.

name: a monitor fired with a threshold and nothing else in the line

alert.name: Monitor 412 triggered
alert.detail: The value on monitor 412 crossed the configured limit.

name: a provider routing event and packet loss on our own path, with the incident open

alert.name: checkout-web page loads timing out
alert.detail: A third of page loads time out before the first byte, and the ones that answer are normal. Our own network monitor shows 4% packet loss between the load balancer and the origin in the same window. The CDN provider status page reports a routing event in the region that serves these loads.

recent_changes.what: raised the log level on the search service to debug

open_incidents.name: checkout-web page load timeouts
open_incidents.detail: Page loads on checkout-web timing out before the first byte, under investigation.
